ActiveSessionId clears when execution stops; no terminal receipt. Manual beginAttributedLaunch validates Working assignment and stores targetAgentId/taskId/assignment snapshot/source digest, but no capacity reservation, role/version, baseline generation or provider session. Native Work candidates have stronger WorkId/generation, RoleId/version, owner/task/attempt and assignment generation, but only for that path.

First effects:
- Manual Client/SignalR/Client.fs: launchAgent.js requires TargetAgentId. NegativeOnly HOLDs; Disabled records intent only when targetAgentId exists, then calls runInNewTabWithObservation. Other script names may omit target; BrowserExecuteFile/BrowserExecuteJs are alternate executable paths.
- Scheduled Client/Program.fs: local action sets TargetAgentId=None. NegativeOnly HOLDs; Disabled calls BrowserBridge.runInNewTab directly without project intent/admission. Schedule state is client-private, not distributed.
- Native AutomationNativeAccountProjectIngress CAS-claims HeldBeforeSend with intent/args; NativeSchedulerAccountReservation counts non-Released native reservations under account/project/role roster. But AutomationNativeProviderSessionHost authorizeProviderDispatch and releaseFromProviderTerminal error; Program challengeWakeEnabled=false/defaultOffHostPorts. WorkQueue intent is preparation-only, preview read-only, private provider bridge HostBridgeUnavailable; no production provider/first-connect/terminal issuer.
- ClientService records best-effort activity and routes ordinary SendCommandToUser by connected session/advertised command; protocol equality is required only for cross-project notifications. Old/offline clients and local/direct execution are not globally fenced. LegacyDirectWriterFence says Git history does not prove all-client pending-intent journal, source-effect journal or minimum-client high-water; route coverage false.

Occupancy: no complete upper bound. Manual intents are conditional on TargetAgentId; scheduled sends bypass project intent; alternate scripts exist; ReviewAgent associations/server activity are not provider terminal evidence; native records cover only native reservations. Missing/old/offline/direct activity is not enumerable. Unknown stays occupied; never infer zero from absence or terminal from stale last-seen, recovery, browser UI outcome, disconnect or timeout.

Safe contract: default-off/HOLD. Baseline generation binds projectId/ledgerId/epoch, policy revision, sender-coverage manifest, source heads/revisions and observation time. Producer independently verifies every in-scope sender and prior effect; no caller completeness boolean. Any uncovered/unknown source => HOLD. Compose baseline, policy, trusted role/owner/attempt/assignment generation and reservation in one retryable LedgerStore.transact; replan each retry; stable operation/effect IDs. Commit one-shot Held->Dispatching before effect. Authenticated provider receipt => Submitted/Active; ambiguous result/crash => Uncertain and occupied; Terminal only with original-bound verified provider receipt; NoSend only with original-bound proof no effect crossed. Exclusion only before Dispatching.

Human boundary: Operator chooses project-only vs account-wide, cooperative Jarvis senders vs all browser/provider launches, and total/per-role caps. Full guarantee needs cutover: pause senders, upgrade/retire old/offline clients, restrict alternate scripts/direct provider access, drain/verify existing sessions. No provider session inventory/terminal API exists; manual attestation is human trust, not machine proof. Alternatives: limited cooperative scope plus attested drain; external provider mediation/inventory for global guarantee; or remain HOLD/default-off. capacityFenceEnabled only blocks manual/scheduled locally; it is not positive admission.
